say:1:1028411001:1.text: You there... wait, I've seen you before! You're from the Dark Forest, yes?
say:1:1028411001:1.source_cn: 你们是……等等，我好像见过你们！你们是从薄暮丛林来的，对吧？

say:2:1028411002:1.text: My name is Theodore, and I'm the captain of the Harvesters.
say:2:1028411002:1.source_cn: 我叫西奥多，是采集队的队长。

say:3:1028411003:1.text: You've been gone for so long without any news that the people of Taran are worried sick. Have you run into any trouble?
say:3:1028411003:1.source_cn: 你们这么久没有音讯，塔兰村里的人很着急，是遇到什么问题了吗？

say:4:1028411004:1.text: Any trouble? We've had nothing BUT trouble.
say:4:1028411004:1.source_cn: 遇到什么问题？我们遇到的全都是问题！

say:5:1028411005:2.text: First, we ran into two <style="highlight">grouchy herbalists</style> who adamantly opposed us harvesting any timber.
say:5:1028411005:2.source_cn: 先是在这里遇到<style=highlight>两个古...

say:6:1028411006:1.text: Wasn't easy to persuade them. Then, overnight, <style="highlight">the trees showed signs of corruption,</style> which quickly spread throughout the entire forest.
say:6:1028411006:1.source_cn: 好容易说服了他们，一夜之间，<style=highli...

say:7:1028411007:1.text: The herbalists said the corruption couldn't be eradicated, so I made a tough call... had the team cut down all the corrupted trees.
say:7:1028411007:1.source_cn: 植物学家说腐化无法清除，没办法，我只好……只好让队员把...

say:8:1028411008:1.text: By Misarte above, we would never intentionally harm the forest! We were just trying to slow the spread of corruption.
say:8:1028411008:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒有灵！我们并不想破坏林场生态，只是希望可以延缓腐...

say:9:1028411009:1.text: So that explains it... no wonder you even cut down the saplings.
say:9:1028411009:1.source_cn: 原来是这样……怪不得你们连小树都伐掉了。

say:10:1028411010:1.text: I feel terrible, but what else could we do? And now it doesn't even seem we've solved the root of the problem.
say:10:1028411010:1.source_cn: 我也心疼啊，可又有什么办法？但谁知道，这法子压根不治本。

say:11:1028411011:1.text: Even after cutting the affected trees, the corruption is still slowly spreading. Those herbalists are a joke!
say:11:1028411011:1.source_cn: 即便砍掉了被腐化的树，腐化仍然在慢慢蔓延，那两个植物学...

say:12:1028411012:1.text: And alas, our troubles are far from over. In the past few days, our group has been falling ill one after another!
say:12:1028411012:1.source_cn: 唉……这还不算完。就这几天，我们队伍里的人也陆续生病了！

say:13:1028411013:1.text: We're all weak, can't eat... the state of the forest aside, we can barely walk...
say:13:1028411013:1.source_cn: 大家都吃不下东西，虚弱无力，别说紧急抢救林场了，现在连...

say:14:1028411014:1.text: We've just had terrible luck all around!

say:16:1028411015:1.text: Don't worry, let my magister investigate！<style="stress"><player_name></style>, there must be something we can do!
say:16:1028411015:1.source_cn: 别担心，让我的主人来为帮你们检查一下吧！<style=...
say:16:1028411015:1.male: Don't worry, let my magister investigate！<style="stress"><player_name></style>, there must be something we can do!
say:16:1028411015:1.female: Don't worry, let my magister investigate！<style="stress"><player_name></style>, there must be something we can do!
